plan: Deep-copy the recipe into a working structure so adapt() never mutates inputs and print_original() can return authored_text byte-for-byte.
Scale all quantities (recipe and components) by Fraction(target_yield)/Fraction(yield) before any substitution, so replacement quantity_factors compose with the yield change.
Build a ranked substitution index: group catalog choices by their 'for' name and sort by (priority, original catalog index) for deterministic selection with catalog-order tie-breaking.

Run a worklist pass over each ingredient list by index so ingredients appended by additional_ingredients are processed too; rewrite each excluded ingredient repeatedly until its name is no longer excluded, tracking a per-chain seen-set to detect substitution cycles.

Applying a choice updates name/quantity/unit/preparation, applies wording_changes as global string rewrites over all instruction lists, applies equipment additions/removals, compensates an optional yield_factor, and queues additional ingredients.

After all rewrites, audit constraints: sort and deduplicate equipment, and record 'equipment NAME unavailable' for anything missing from available_equipment; reasons accumulate in a set so every independently applicable reason is reported, not just the first.
Return {possible, recipe, choices, warnings, reasons} with sorted warnings/reasons; on failure recipe is None but choices retain what was considered.
Include a __main__ self-test covering all seven acceptance-contract scenarios.
mechanisms: deep-copy working state preserving the authored original
ranked substitution index keyed by name, sorted by (priority, catalog index)
index-based worklist over a growing ingredient list for chained and added-ingredient substitutions
end-of-pass constraint audit accumulating all reasons in a set
sorted deterministic output of warnings, reasons, and equipment
